status: Exploratory sensitivity added after the baseline analysis; not preregistered
population: Baseline direction-oriented, comparable, rated papers, separately by estimand
rating: Frozen TrueSkill mu; no imputation or annulled/unrated papers
rank: Midrank percentile (average rank minus 0.5) / N within the common analysis sample
heterogeneity: Estimate ordinary REML tau squared on the common rated sample; hold it common across multipliers in each point estimate
inference: Paired independent-paper percentile bootstrap; recompute ranks and REML heterogeneity in each draw; conditional on frozen ratings and directions
rating_groups: Below versus at or above the common-sample median mu; ordinary REML with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals
interpretation: Bounded rating emphasis changes the corpus summary. It is not a validated risk-of-bias correction. Rating uncertainty and dependence across papers are not resolved by these intervals.
